content:
Maya: Heads-up — Compliance requested an export that ties routing policy changes to tenant IDs and rollout context. They want a "who changed what/when" view + policy delta, and ability to filter by org. Thoughts on fields + UI?
Priya: Main concern: PII. Do we include actor email or only an ID/hash? Also legal may need justification text preserved.
Alex: Proposal: include actor_id, actor_email (redacted/hashed by default), actor_role, change_type, field_path, old_value, new_value, timestamp, rollout_id, route_id, tenant_id, justification, audit_event_id
Sam: Example NDJSON line we could emit:
```
{"actor_id":"u_123","actor_email":"[redacted]","actor_role":"admin","change_type":"update","field_path":"/routing/policy/allow_list","old_value":"[]","new_value":"[acct:acme]","timestamp":"2026-03-19T21:00:12Z","rollout_id":"r_789","route_id":"route-4","tenant_id":"t_acme","justification":"emergency access","audit_event_id":"evt_987"}
```
Kevin: Export size will be huge if we include full JSON diffs. We need sampling/streaming and export quotas. Also export ACLs + signed URL retention (short TTL).
Priya: Telemetry ask: add correlation_id + trace_id so we can link export entries back to console traces and dashboards.
Maya: UI notes: we should offer quick-filter by tenant, timeline scrub by date, and a compact "diff preview" in the console before download. Downloads should be a signed URL and the download itself should be recorded in audit logs.
Alex: For rollouts, we should include rollout_phase and percent_traffic at time-of-change so customers can map policy change to rollout state.
Sam: Backend idea: reuse the changefeed stream but include a compact 'delta' field with path-level diffs. We can also emit separate route-hash to avoid repeating big blobs.
audit-bot: export job started for tenant t_acme, job_id: export_20260319_001
Kevin: Ops request: enforce export quota per org (default 25GB/day). If a job exceeds, either fail or split into paged exports. Need cost estimate.
Priya: PII redaction modes: none | partial | hashed. Default partial: redact emails but keep actor_id; include redaction_reason meta field per line.
Maya: Action items: (1) Console UX mock for timeline + diff preview, (2) API shape for NDJSON export + streaming, (3) RBAC for who can request exports, (4) sampling/retention policy options. Volunteers?
Alex: I'll take API shape + OpenAPI snippets. ETA EOW.
Sam: I'll prototype NDJSON streamer + signed-url flow. Will try to reuse existing changefeed consumer.
Priya: I'll draft PII redaction policy + compliance matrix and examples.
Maya: Great. @Kevin can you add retention defaults and quota knobs to the infra task list? Also ping legal after initial designs :pray:
Kevin: Yep — will add retention defaults (30/90/365 days), and a quota feature flag for rollout.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll collate notes and set up a short sync on Friday to review mocks.
